g.text: P123-RFI-0002 · Conflict in piling and utilities at AZ203
Subject Conflict in piling and utilities at AZ203
Question The piling layout in revision B puts pile P-17 inside the route of the fuel gas line 47-P-101, and the utilities drawing
shows the same corridor for the cooling water return. Please confirm which of the two keeps the corridor, whether the pile can move 400 mm to the east
without a new load calculation, and whether the cooling water line may be re-routed above the beam B12 if the pile stays where it is. We need the
answer before the pile cap formwork is ordered.
2026-10-13 dora: Answer rejected - The beam moved in revision C; please check again.
2026-10-13 System: Answer required clock met - Answered
